lines: Oh my goodness, a new face! Welcome, welcome! I'm Dottie, I run the Maple Inn, well, me and Kip, well, Kip runs everything a little bit, have you met Kip?
Oh you will, sweetheart, you will. He'll sell you a pumpkin, a stamp and a fire safety leaflet in one go.
Isn't it a lovely morning? I said that to the postman, and the postman said 'it's raining, Dottie' and I said 'lovely for ducks!'
Just having a little sit and a little chat. Did you know Mrs. Wren has a new clock? Ninety years old, and it only chimes on Tuesdays!
The gazebo looks so pretty at night. Mr. Palmer put the lights up himself, bless him. Well, someone helped. Was it you? I bet it was you.

rotate: Guests at the inn this week: a man who collects spoons, two ladies who only eat soup, and a very quiet gentleman who asked about the old oak. Isn't that funny?
Have you tried Poppy's cauldron cakes? They're green inside! For Halloween! I had three. Don't tell my doctor.
Sometimes at midnight I hear a whoosh from the green. Probably the wind. Probably! Ha!
You come back any time, sweetheart. The kettle's always on.
